ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All directors, shareholders, and ultimate beneficial owners must be screened against the Financial Intelligence Unit of Belize's Political Exposed Persons list, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, and HM Treasury sanctions list. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for PEPs, negative media checks, and adverse legal history reviews. Submission of identity documents and source of funds declarations is required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Companies Registry of Belize - Online Name Reservation Portal (https://www.belizecompaniesregistry.gov.bz)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be in English or using Latin-script transliteration from a foreign language; the name may include numbers and punctuation accepted by the Registry. The desired name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Ltd.', 'Corp.', 'Inc.', or the equivalent abbreviation.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name is rejected by the Companies Registry, the applicant or its registered agent may file a formal written appeal with the Registrar of Companies within 21 days of the rejection notice. The appeal must restate the proposed name, provide evidence of compliance with Section 10 of the International Business Companies Act, and request a reconsideration. The Registrar must issue a written decision within 15 business days. If the appeal is denied, the applicant may apply for a new name reservation or seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Belize.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physical registered office address in Belize maintained by a licensed registered agent is mandatory. Virtual office arrangements for the company's operating activities are acceptable for an IBC in the programmatic advertising industry provided that the registered agent retains custody of statutory records and can produce them upon demand. Remote business management and cloud-based operations do not violate the substance requirements for a tax-exempt IBC.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 5% (low likelihood; unannounced physical inspections are rare for non-licensed, low-risk IBCs but remain legally permissible under the Registered Agent regulatory framework if AML concerns arise)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Chapter 270 of the Substantive Laws of Belize (Revised Edition 2020), ss. 6 (incorporation), 8 (registered office and registered agent), 33 (directors and officers), 77 (records).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies Registry, International Business Companies Unit (Registrar of International Business Companies), Ministry of Financial Services, Belize City, Belize.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form CO-1) under s. 6 of the IBC Act together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, Notice of Appointment of Registered Agent, and Notice of Registered Office.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up or authorized capital requirement; incorporation with one (1) no-par-value ordinary share is permitted. No escrow deposit or capital verification is statutorily required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, THAT the Company shall adopt and ratify its Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Registrar of International Business Companies; THAT the subscription of the founding shareholder be approved and one (1) fully paid no-par-value ordinary share be allotted and issued; THAT the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address of the licensed registered agent in Belize City, Belize; THAT [NAME] be and is hereby appointed President and Chief Executive Officer and [NAME] be appointed Secretary, each with authority to open bank accounts, designate signatories, and execute contracts; AND THAT the corporate seal be adopted and certified copies of this resolution be issued to banks and third parties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, International Business Companies Unit (name search desk; electronic search via licensed registered agents).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed corporate names for a conflicts search against the Belize IBC register and local companies register. A name containing restricted words (e.g. bank, trust, insurance) requires ministerial consent and is not permissible for a standard IBC. Upon clearance, the name may be informally reserved by the registered agent for up to 90 days.
required_dossiers: Proposed corporate names (primary and two alternatives)
Passport copy of the incorporator or applicant
Brief statement of intended business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or flagged as confusingly similar, select an alternative cleared name or file a written submission for consent to adopt a deceptively similar name, with supporting trademark or goodwill evidence where applicable.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding subscriber and licensed registered agent (the registered agent is a licensed attorney or trust company under the IBC Act).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the statutory form, specifying share structure, restricted objects (if any), director provisions, and the appointment of the registered agent. The subscriber executes the memorandum before a notary public; the registered agent executes the consent to act and the notice of registered office. Documents are notarized and where required, apostilled or dispatched electronically to the Registry.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (executed and notarized)
Consent of Registered Agent to Act (Form CO-2)
Certified passport copy and proof of residential address of the subscriber/director
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries formal defects (e.g. inconsistent schedules or missing notarial stamp), the registered agent resubmits corrected signature pages or an amended memorandum within the Registry's reply period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies Registry, International Business Companies Unit (counter filing or electronic portal through the registered agent).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Application for Incorporation together with the constitutional documents and statutory consents. Pay the government filing fee of USD 200 (standard authorized capital) and any same-day or 24-hour expedited fee, if selected. The Registrar issues a receipt and assigns a company number.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of Registered Agent and Notice of Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is requisitioned, the registered agent files a letter of response and corrected documents within the statutory deadline; if the requisition is misconceived, the agent submits a formal legal submission citing ss. 6-8 of the IBC Act.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registrar registers the company, enters it in the IBC register, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation and a certified copy of the Memorandum and Articles. The company acquires separate legal personality as of the date of the certificate.
required_dossiers: Registry file number (internal reference only; no separate user submission)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors or incorrect company details, the registered agent files a formal application for reissuance with the Registry Clerk, supported by the original erroneous certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Organization, Bank Account Opening, and Annual Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent, first directors, and corporate secretary acting with the chosen correspondent bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (or pass the written first resolution), issue the subscriber share certificate, adopt share register and seal, approve banking resolutions, and execute the corporate bank account application with certified corporate documents. Calendar the annual license fee (due by 31 August) and any economic substance filing obligation applicable to active companies.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies and proof of address for directors and ultimate beneficial owners
Bank account application and banker's reference letters
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide a corporate structure chart and source-of-funds declaration; if the annual license fee is overdue, pay the arrears plus late penalty and, if struck off, apply for reinstatement under the IBC Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No domain-specific industrial licensing board applies to a pure programmatic advertising DSP/SSP platform operating remotely as a Belize IBC; general business facilitation and voluntary licensing matters are handled by the Belize Trade and Investment Development Service (BELTRAIDE).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Statutorily Mandated for Offshore IBC Digital Operations; optional 'General Service Business License' under the local Business Licensing regime applies only if the company maintains a physical retail or service premises in Belize.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment (DOE), Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category Exempt (Class C) - the activity is purely digital and is not listed under the Schedule of Projects requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment; no construction, land disturbance, or point-source discharge is involved.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable - zero on-site wastewater, VOC, or hazardous waste generation; server and ad-serving infrastructure is hosted on third-party cloud providers outside Belize. If a physical data center were ever established in Belize, the National Effluent Limitations and Air Emission Standards would apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable to a remote digital operation without physical premises. If the company later leases an office in Belize, it must obtain fire safety certification from the Belize National Fire Service, a structural load and occupancy clearance from the local Building Authority, and workplace safety registration with the Labour Department.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service Department, Ministry of Finance (portal: https://www.taxservice.gov.bz); customs matters administered by the Customs and Excise Department (https://www.customs.gov.bz)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Belize International Business Company (IBC) is incorporated under the International Business Companies Act (Cap. 270) and is automatically registered for tax ID purposes by the Registrar of Companies. To obtain the statutory Tax Identification Number (TIN), the IBC must submit to the Tax Service Department: (i) taxpayer registration application form; (ii) certificate of incorporation; (iii) registered office/registered agent details; (iv) certified passport copies of directors and ultimate beneficial owners; and (v) statement of exempt status under the IBC Act. The TIN is issued within 7-10 business days. The IBC must also register for General Sales Tax (GST) if annual taxable turnover reaches BZD 150,000.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Belize has no check-the-box or OECD hybrid-mismatch election statute. The IBC Act provides elective instruments: (i) election to receive a Ministerial Certificate of Tax Exemption (irrevocable 50-year zero-tax guarantee); (ii) election to convert an IBC into a domestic company under the Companies Act, thereby entering the ordinary Belize income tax and GST regime; (iii) election of registered-share capital mode for transparency; and (iv) election for annual return-based taxpayer verification. A domestic Belize company may also elect to redomicile as an IBC, which resets taxable status to exempt.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Sales Tax (GST) — value-added style consumption tax under the General Sales Tax Act, Cap. 68
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZD 150,000 annual taxable turnover (approx. USD 75,000) within a 12-month period; non-resident digital-service suppliers with substantive Belize nexus (local ad inventory/SSP buyers) are registrable if they exceed the threshold, although Belize does not yet operate a separate digital-services tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction control, digital stamping, or API-based e-invoicing mandate exists in Belize. GST-registered persons must issue sequential pre-numbered tax invoices, retain electronic copies for 6 years, and file monthly/quarterly GST returns through the Tax Service Department online portal (e-filing with JSON/PDF attachment, scheduled payment via Swift Wire/ACH). Approved B2B e-invoicing is permitted, but there is no government clearance database for export invoices; physical evidence packet must be kept for audit.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: GST zero-rating is claimable for (i) goods physically exported from Belize under customs supervision; and (ii) services supplied by an IBC to a non-resident of Belize where the benefit is consumed wholly outside Belize. For programmatic ad DSP/SSP services, zero-rating applies when the contracting customer is a non-resident ad network/advertiser/publisher, the campaign delivery geographies are outside Belize, and the IBC maintains documentary evidence of the offshore place-of-supply, non-resident status of the counterparty, and no Belize-based recipient of the service.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Customs Form C-10 / electronic manifest filing)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Belize
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Commercial invoice describing service/goods with HTS/ISIC coding
Packing list (for goods) or service delivery report (for ad-tech services) evidencing offshore consumption
GST zero-rating certificate and counterparty non-resident declaration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Belize has no mandatory FX repatriation statute; however, for audit substantiation the tax authority may inspect the export packet within 4 years (6 years for fraud). False zero-rating/refund claims trigger: GST refund clawback with 200% penalty plus interest at 8% per annum; customs fraud penalties up to 5 times the duty and forfeiture of goods; criminal liability for wilful evasion; and administrative deregistration of the IBC's tax-exempt certificate under the IBC Act for carrying on prohibited domestic business. The Tax Service cross-checks against the IBC annual return and bank records.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Belize (established under the Central Bank of Belize Act, Chapter 262, Laws of Belize), acting as the sole monetary authority, bank licensing supervisor, and statutory exchange-control administrator; exchange-control administration is delegated to authorized dealers (licensed commercial banks) under the Exchange Control Act, Chapter 263, Laws of Belize.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar is legally pegged to the US dollar at BZD 2.00 = USD 1.00 under a fixed-rate regime effective since 1976. Current-account transactions (trade in services including programmatic advertising) are freely convertible against documentary proof of the underlying transaction. Capital-account transactions (equity injections, inter-company loans, offshore investments) require exchange-control filing or approval for resident entities; however, an International Business Company (IBC) registered under the IBC Act, Chapter 270, Laws of Belize, is statutorily exempt from the Exchange Control Act where it transacts in foreign currency or maintains an external account. Profit remittance and dividend distribution by an IBC are unrestricted because the IBC enjoys zero corporate income tax, zero withholding tax, and no capital gains tax in Belize; only bank-level documentary review (audited or management accounts, platform revenue invoices, registered agent certificate) is triggered. The practical hurdle is not convertibility but source-of-funds substantiation: an undercapitalized IBC with high-velocity programmatic ad receipts requires a detailed commercial narrative to pass bank-level economic sanity checks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Act (Cap. 263) and its General Orders, a resident exporter of goods or services must receive payment within 180 days of the shipment or service date and must surrender all foreign-currency export proceeds to an authorized dealer in exchange for Belize dollars (statutory surrender ratio is 100% of export receipts). However, an IBC is deemed non-resident for exchange-control purposes where it operates in a foreign currency or through an external account; Section 6 of the IBC Act expressly disapplies the Exchange Control Act to such an IBC. Consequently, the 180-day surrender timeline and the mandatory 100% conversion requirement are not applicable to the IBC, provided that: (i) all treasury flows are denominated in USD or another freely convertible foreign currency; (ii) the Belize bank account is classified and maintained as an 'external account'; and (iii) the IBC does not conduct domestic Belize-dollar business.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational USD Account (external account ledger)
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (USD current and settlement account, correspondent-backed)
International Offshore Account (Class A offshore banking license, USD multi-currency)
Operational USD Settlement Account (regional cross-border liquidity hub)
Operational Account (state-owned development focus; less suited to offshore IBC treasury)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Belize has no standalone Electronic Money Institution (EMI) licensing framework; non-bank payment service providers must obtain a money remittance or currency-exchange license under the Banks and Financial Institutions Act (Cap. 266) or register as money services businesses under the AML/CFT Act. International digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) cannot be used as the primary inbound clearing rail for Belize because Belize is outside SEPA and no international EMI passporting regime exists. EMIs are structurally viable only as downstream outbound payment rails for sub-disbursements (e.g., LATAM contractor payouts or media supplier settlements) once funds have been cleared into a Belize-licensed external USD account. Legal constraint: any EMI arrangement must not be structured to circumvent Belize exchange-control or AML/CFT obligations; the licensed Belize bank's settlement account must remain the treasury anchor.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote account opening is not a statutory entitlement and is permitted only on a risk-adjusted basis. The Central Bank of Belize AML/CFT Guidelines require licensed banks to positively identify and verify the identity of all signatories and ultimate beneficial owners. In practice, the onboarding protocols are: (i) physical attendance of at least one director or the UBO at the bank's Belize branch for a face-to-face interview is generally mandated by tier-one commercial banks (Atlantic Bank, Belize Bank, CIBC FCIB); (ii) certain offshore-licensed banks (Caye International Bank) accept fully remote opening where identity documents are notarized in a FATF-compliant jurisdiction, apostilled or consular-legalized, accompanied by a live video KYC interview and a bank-to-bank reference (SWIFT MT199) confirmed through the applicant's home correspondent bank; (iii) a Belize-licensed registered agent's Corporate Certificate of Incumbency and supporting AML attestation materially reduces the physical-presence burden. Recommendation: designate the UBO for a single physical onboarding visit to Belize City; if physically impossible, appoint a Belize-based professional director or corporate officer under a notarized Power of Attorney and complete the video interview at a scheduled escalation-officer session.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership opacity — bearer shares or layered nominee structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Good Standing from the Belize Companies Registry; IBC Register Extract; Statutory UBO Register declaration (name, date of birth, nationality, residential address, PEP status, % ownership); Registered Agent's AML Certificate of Incumbency; Articles of Incorporation and By-Laws; an organizational chart evidencing the 100% ownership chain from the UBOs to the entity; notarized passports and proof of residence for all signatories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Revenue-conduct mismatch — tax-exempt offshore corporate form combined with high-velocity, low-value programmatic AdTech receipts (many micro-payments from DSP/SSP participants).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written commercial narrative describing the ISIC 7310 platform model and SSP/Ad-Exchange architecture; signed Master Services Agreements with demand-side and supply-side partners; consolidated invoice samples with platform transaction references; a 6-month traffic and settlement reconciliation report; board-approved financial projections and business plan; UBO curriculum vitae showing AdTech domain experience; compliance undertaking to produce transaction-level records upon request.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Belize jurisdictional risk flags — negative international perception (offshore secrecy, past EU AML listing, regulatory scrutiny by foreign correspondent banks).
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legal opinion confirming the IBC is outside the relevant-activities list for Belize economic substance purposes (digital advertising is not a scheduled relevant activity); tax-residency statement confirming the entity is not tax-resident in Belize; CRS/GATCA registration certificate if any financial account reporting obligation is triggered; third-party adverse-media/negative-news report; sanctions-list and PEP screening results for all UBOs; letters of reference from the home-country bank and legal counsel in an FATF-compliant jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions false-positive screening — the legal name contains a country/offshore keyword ('Belize') causing automatic transaction-holding by foreign correspondent banks.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Exact legal entity name and registered office address quote to be embedded in the SWIFT field 50/56/59 to prevent name-match; Sanction Screening Certificate from the registered agent; a pre-issued compliance packet (AML checklist, source of funds letter, invoice copy) sent directly to the Belize bank's compliance desk 48 hours before the first inbound wire; establishment of a permanent 'pre-cleared beneficiary' profile with the paying bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity injections are executed via standard SWIFT MT103 from the UBO's home-country bank to the Belize IBC's external USD account. The Remittance Information field (field 70) must read: 'Capital contribution for operating expenses — IBC No. [registration number] — ISIC 7310 programmatic advertising platform'. The applicable SWIFT purpose code is 'TRAN' (transfer between related accounts) or 'CASH' (cash flow management); codes implying investment into Belize domestic securities or 'TOCC' grants must not be used. Because the IBC is exchange-control exempt and the account is classified as an external account, prior Central Bank approval is not required; nevertheless, the Belize receiving bank must log the credit against the external-account ledger and may request a Source-of-Funds Declaration, the UBO's bank statement showing account opening history, and a board resolution authorizing the capital injection. For injections exceeding USD 1,000,000, route the credit via the bank's US correspondent (e.g., Wells Fargo for Atlantic Bank, Bank of America for Belize Bank) and pre-clear the transaction with the Belize compliance desk using the same KYC dossier to avoid SWIFT holds. The use of an Escrow Account is mandatory until initial UBO verification and platform counterparty contracts have been validated.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The primary clearing rail for vendor and supplier settlements is the SWIFT MT103 (single customer credit transfer) with the invoice number, invoice date, and service descriptor embedded in field 70; the Belize bank applies de facto automatic current-account remittance approval where the payee and amount reconcile to the filed commercial narrative and no sanctions flag is raised. Intercompany treasury movements between the IBC and any sister holding entities are executed via SWIFT MT202/MT103 tagged with ISO 20022 code 'INTRA' and supported by a board resolution and latest management accounts. For high-value media-inventory purchases exceeding USD 250,000 per settlement cycle, a Commercial Letter of Credit is constructively permissible but practically limited: Belize banks will only issue fully cash-covered documentary credits or MT760 standby letters of credit, because digital goods/media services do not fit traditional trade-documentary examination; the standby LC is therefore recommended solely as a payment guarantee with the underlying settlement still executed by MT103. For LATAM contractor payouts, the IBC may combine a Belize MT103 to the contractor's local bank, or use an integrated fintech sub-disbursement rail (e.g., a licensed money remitter in Mexico, Guatemala, or Colombia) funded from the external USD account; all sub-disbursements must be traceable to the master settlement ledger to satisfy the bank's periodic review.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts with a Belize-licensed authorized dealer (hedging EUR/USD and GBP/USD exposure from European ad buyers; tenor up to 12 months; underlying commercial invoices required)
Vanilla FX options (European-style EUR/USD and GBP/USD protective puts and calls) purchased through an international investment-grade counterparty outside Belize jurisdiction

Cross-currency swaps (payment-versus-payment collateralized) under an ISDA master agreement between the IBC and an offshore FATF-compliant bank, converting USD revenue streams into EUR/GBP for matched media purchase and sales cycles

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) quoted against the USD/BZD pegged rate solely as a treasury liquidity overlay, tenor limited to 6 months and executed via an offshore dealer desk, not a Belize domestic bank

FX overlay on a cash-collateral basis through the Belize bank's treasury desk for net settlement balancing of multi-currency programmatic receivables, provided documentation of the underlying current-account transactions is maintained

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: IBC Annual Return and Annual License Fee (annual return prescribed under s. 83, International Business Companies Act, Chap. 270, Rev. 2020)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Belmopan, Belize
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary rule: filing due within 3 months after each annual incorporation anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual license fee; if the fee and annual return remain unpaid more than 3 months after the due date, the Registrar may strike off and dissolve the IBC without further notice, causing assets to vest in the Crown and loss of limited liability protection; reinstatement requires settlement of all arrears, penalties, and restoration fees

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Economic Substance Notification (ESN) and relevant-activity declaration under the Economic Substance Act, 2019 (as amended); the programmatic ad exchange/SSP platform must assess whether its operations constitute a relevant activity (distribution and service centre or intellectual property business)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Economic Substance Competent Authority, submitted through the Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 3 months after the end of the IBC's financial year (calendar-year filers: by 31 March), coordinated with the annual return anniversary filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file the ESN is a strict-liability offence attracting a civil fine of up to US$5,000 plus daily continuing penalties for persistent default; the competent authority may initiate economic-substance review and the Registrar may strike off the company for continued non-compliance

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for a standard Belize IBC: audited financial statements and a statutory audit are not mandatory under the IBC Act regardless of revenue, asset, or headcount thresholds; an audit becomes compulsory only if the IBC separately holds a regulated licence (e.g., bank, insurance company, fund administrator, trust company) under IFSC-regulated legislation
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as issued by the IASB for voluntary financial statements; the directors must keep accounting records sufficient to explain transactions and disclose the financial position with reasonable accuracy, but no financial statements are filed with the Registry

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The IBC must keep a register of members and a central register of beneficial owners at the Belize registered office. Every share transfer must be recorded in the register of members, and the resulting change in beneficial ownership must be filed with the CCAR within 15 days. No standalone annual UBO return exists; director, member, and UBO particulars are refreshed in the annual return filed at each incorporation anniversary, and the registered agent conducts an annual KYC/AML refresh confirming the UBO schedule and shareholding continuity

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$750 - US$1,500 per year (registered agent retainer covering registered office, registered agent services, annual return preparation, ESN filing, and UBO register maintenance)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable - no statutory audit; voluntary certified audit, if requested by advertisers, exchanges, or acquirers, ranges from US$3,000 to US$10,000 depending on transaction volume and revenue documentation

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (total statutory exemption for International Business Companies under the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270; the domestic resident-company headline rate of 25% under the Income and Business Tax Act does not apply to IBCs)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Permanent 100% exemption from Belize income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, and stamp duty on share and asset transfers; annual flat government license fee of US$100 to US$1,000 based on authorized capital replaces any profit-based tax; no tax holiday or preferential deduction is required because the statutory rate is already zero.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: IBC Annual Return (Form AR) plus Annual Government License Fee remittance, lodged with the Registrar of International Business Companies through the International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) e-Services portal; the licensed Belize registered agent must counter-sign and submit.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation and in every subsequent year; the annual license fee is payable in full at the same time, without audited financial statements being required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered IBC name and unique registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Transcribe the exact name and Reg. No. from the Certificate of Incorporation (e.g., Reg. No. 000012345-IBC); a prior name change must be evidenced by Registrar approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Belize registered office street address maintained by the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The address must be the agent's registered Belize address; a non-resident IBC maintains no other required physical presence in Belize.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized share capital, issued shares, and class rights, used to compute the government fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Declare capital precisely, e.g., US$50,000 divided into 50,000 common shares; confirm no bearer shares remain outstanding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual government fee payable by fee band.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: US$100 minimum up to US$1,000 maximum depending on authorized capital; remit via the registered agent or directly through the IFSC portal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Counter-signature and IFSC license number of the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners must instruct the agent in writing; the agent bears separate IFSC disciplinary liability for filing defects.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company transacted no Belize-sourced business and holds no Belize domestic real property.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Any domestic Belize activity voids the exemption for those transactions; if SSP or ad-servicing contracts have Belize counterparties, seek tax counsel before signing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the Directors' Register, Members' Register, and Beneficial Ownership Register are held at the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Director and UBO identities are not publicly filed; registers must be physically accessible to IFSC and the Financial Intelligence Unit under the Beneficial Ownership Act, 2019.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a penalty of US$200 per month or part month, plus 10% statutory interest on the unpaid annual license fee; three consecutive defaults trigger Registrar strike-off and dissolution; restoration costs US$400 plus all arrears; false declarations attract IFSC suspension and fines up to BZ$25,000.
